decision_scope.first_selection_rule: geometry-only entropy over two shared ±8 mm particles at both full widths
decision_scope.tail_candidates: all 15-degree checked target windows for each included pair
decision_scope.tail_cost: DynamicScan checked cost from selected source window to each target window
decision_scope.A: one fixed suffix maximizing expected branch value
decision_scope.B: outcome-feedback suffix maximizing each branch then averaging
decision_scope.adaptive_greedy: same branchwise posterior expected-capture suffix as B
